items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: Well we had Talbot, Slow Drag, Elton Pornell, George Lewis, Lawrence Moreira and myself.

ctx.x: Well we worked there for a couple of years. Who do you have in the band then?
Well we had Talbot, Slow Drag, Elton Pornell, George Lewis, Lawrence Moreira and myself. That was the old regular lineup.

items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1960-03-16
items.q: Well, the most I knew about Elmer was when he was playing with us. I never met him before until he joined up with us.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, I was going to ask a little bit, we only have another minute left, about Elmer Talbert. If you can tell us anything about him since he's not here to talk for himself.
Well, the most I knew about Elmer was when he was playing with us. I never met him before until he joined up with us.
Well, I thought he came from uptown there too. Maybe you'd know him.

items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1969-03-24
items.q: I know there was Elmer Talbot on trumpet, Slowdrek on bass, George.

ctx.x: Yes, indeed. Do you remember when you made those records for Souchon? Yeah, at Bedita and Verone. Tell me about that, what you can remember about that.

Well, I don't remember much about that. I know there was Elmer Talbot on trumpet, Slowdrek on bass, George. You don't remember the circumstances? I don't think we had any piano. And we had a song banjo. I think it was six of us. Well, we played up on the second floor. Right up over that music, they had a music store then, downstairs on the first floor. And we played upstairs on the second floor. And we, I think we stopped around about eight o'clock. And we didn't wind up till two o'clock the next morning. So we…
